Subject: Request: Short-term evaluation tokens while procurement verifies vendor setup

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great to see how Somnus is thinking about clinical summarization at scale. Per our conversation I understand procurement is still setting up your vendor profile, and you expect a PO to be issued next week.

To avoid interrupting the evaluation window for the clinical team, would Redwood be able to provide a short-term sandbox top-up (non-billable) while procurement completes the vendor setup? Proposed terms: 25,000 extra tokens valid for 5 days, one-time only, usage reporting back to your technical lead.

If that works, we’ll provide a usage projection and a brief acknowledgement that the credit is temporary and will be reconciled against the PO once it comes through. We can also schedule a 30-min call to hand off the environment to your engineers.

Attachment: usage_projection_q2.xlsx (stub - projected token consumption by test suite)

Can you confirm whether that level is acceptable or whether procurement requires a lower cap or formal approval? Happy to loop in finance/legal for a lightweight acknowledgment.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

Hi Jasmine,

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the proposed bridge. Procurement is moving the vendor set-up through our GPO but it’s held for a couple of compliance checks (DPA + supplier risk questionnaire). They typically won’t sign-off for values over $1,000 without a PO on file.

Two quick asks from our side: 1) can Redwood cap the token grant to an equivalent of $750, and 2) provide a one-page credit acknowledgement that procurement can attach to the PO when it’s raised. We also need to know if the sandbox environment will handle PHI in any way (our security team is strict).

If you can send the short acknowledgement and confirm the $750 cap, I’ll flag it with procurement and try to expedite the PO.

Thanks,
